text:
Elena (People Ops): Quick update — starting Monday we'll be piloting a preregistration + alternate-hub-days program at the SF hub to help with capacity while transit disruptions continue. Please read below and share with any external guests. :spiral_calendar:

Elena (People Ops): TL;DR: guests must be preregistered 24h in advance, headcount cap of 45 per day, and we’re assigning open days by team to keep density even. Shuttle sign-up and guest form links below. :link: https://redwood.internal/forms/hub-guest-prereg and https://redwood.internal/shuttle/sf-strike

Jon (Eng): thanks — how long is this running for?

Elena (People Ops): for now 2 weeks (Mon 2/8 — Fri 2/19) and we'll reassess. if strikes continue we may extend.

Priya (DevEx): Are vendors/contractors allowed?

Marta (People Ops): yes, contractors allowed but must be on the prereg list and have a sponsor from the hosting team. badge pickup still at lobby, but bring ID.

Carlos (Sales): If I have a customer visiting, can I request an exception for extra headcount?

Elena (People Ops): We can approve occasional exceptions (sales/demos). Please ping me directly with date, expected headcount, and reason. We’ll try to accommodate but no guarantees during peak days.

Jon (Eng): shuttle schedule?

Marta (People Ops): Shuttle runs 7:30am (Downtown -> SF hub) and 6:15pm (hub -> Downtown) weekdays. Limited seats — signup first-come. Link above. If shuttle fills up, we’ll add a standby van at 7:45am. :bus:

IT Support: Heads up — if someone needs a loaner laptop while on site (airgapped testing or contractor), open a ticket with subject "SF hub loaner" and include dates. We have 6 loaners reserved for the pilot.

Facilities Bot: Security desk hours adjusted for pilot: 8:00 — 18:00. After-hours access requires prior approval and escort.

Priya (DevEx): Any changes to hot-desk booking?

Elena (People Ops): Yes — please book desks as usual. We’ve increased the booking window to 7 days ahead for pilot participants to coordinate with guest schedules.

Carlos (Sales): Will there be food options? (customer lunch)

Marta (People Ops): Catering requests still allowed but must be submitted 72h in advance. For external guests, caterers must be building-approved — include vendor name in the request.

Jon (Eng): Cool. quick note for teams: rotate onsite days so we don't all show up monday/tuesday.

Elena (People Ops): Exactly — we’ll email team leads with suggested alternating schedule, but feel free to coordinate among yourselves. Final reminder: prereg form required for every external visitor, 24h notice. Questions -> #people-ops or DM me. :thumbsup:
